Welcome to my blog! It actually has a name, "YourQuery" ("你怎样想" in Chinese, and YQ is the abbreviation of my name "Yiqing"). It was first used as my WeChat public account to share my thoughts, but has been resting for a long time lol. Now I've decided to revive it here on my website, where I can share my research ideas, progress, and any creative endeavors :)
